description: Sends a started campaign's drafted messages that are ready, on your person's order, as Send in its Ready to send does, as Manual sends under the business's Sending setting, spread over the campaign's send window. First call without confirm_token: nothing is sent; you get a preview (each person and the exact finished text they get, up to 50 at a time) and a confirm_token. Show your person the preview word for word, and only after they say yes, call again with the same arguments and the SAME idempotency_key, plus confirm_token: exactly the messages shown are sent. If Sending is switched off the answer says so with the link; only the owner turns it on, in Sergio. Never send something nobody asked for.

confirm_token.description: From the preview, after your person said yes. Leave it out to get the preview.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: send_campaign_messages
title: Send a campaign's ready messages (after your person confirms)
